Earthquake Rocks Colombia, Causing Damage

An earthquake with a magnitude of 6.1 struck Colombia on Tuesday, with its epicenter near the town of Los Santos in the department of Santander. The tremor was felt across the country, including in the capital Bogotá, causing panic and shaking buildings. Eyewitness video captured the earthquake rocking a Colombian airport. In Cali, one of the hardest-hit cities, reporting described scenes of rubble from damaged apartment buildings.
